name: ship-coins v1 - place one shipment for a paid order

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: The store posts order.paid (schema 2) here. Authentication is the HMAC in Verify Request, not an n8n credential, so nothing is attached. Raw Body must stay on.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Paste the real values here after import - N8N_ORDER_PAID_KEY: the store's publisher identity, compared with X-ArabUT-Key; N8N_ORDER_PAID_SECRET: HMAC secret of the incoming request, 32+ characters, same value as on the store; N8N_FULFILLMENT_KEY: X-ArabUT-Key the store expects on the placement report; N8N_FULFILLMENT_SECRET: HMAC secret of the placement report, 32+ characters, same value as on the store; FFT_API_USER: FuTTransfer API user; FFT_API_KEY: FuTTransfer API key; UTT_API_KEY: UT Auto Transfer API key; ARABUT_STORE_URL: the store origin - ships filled in, change only for a staging store. Keep "Include Other Input Fields" and "Include Binary" on.

nodes.name: Needs Challenge Price?
nodes.notes: True = the shipment funds a challenge, and FFT has to price it first. False = plain coins.

nodes.name: Slow Shipping?
nodes.notes: v14. True = slow console delivery, which always goes to FFT (cycle when UTT cards are out). False = choose a supplier.

nodes.name: Supplier Switch
nodes.notes: v14. True = UTT was chosen: check the FFT cooldown status first. False = FFT.

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { try { const d = $json.data; const p = typeof d === 'string' ? JSON.parse(d) : (d || $json); return p.isReady === true; } catch(e) { return false; } })() }}

nodes.name: Cooldown OK?
nodes.notes: v14, ported as it was: isReady true sends the UTT order, false falls back to FFT.

parameters.name: transferMethod

nodes.name: Report Placement
nodes.notes: Runs once per funded item. Signed with N8N_FULFILLMENT_KEY / N8N_FULFILLMENT_SECRET from the Config node, the store-side credential of the placement endpoint (docs/api/n8n-fulfillment-v1.md).

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: acknowledged:false while other shipments remain - the store retries with what is still unplaced. A throw anywhere before this node answers 500, which the store also treats as "retry later".
